title: Modelling framework for hierachical ecological impact analysis
text: hibiiscus R package conducting ecological impact analyses hierarchical data. allows reproducible workflows spanning data preparation, model fitting, impact estimation model projection new covariates. incorporates functionality estimating range ecological/biodiversity indicators (taxonomic diversity), fitting frequentist Bayesian models, model evaluation (including cross-validation, area--applicability, Meyer Pebesma, 2021). hibiiscus based R6 Classes (objects) data components internally stored data.frame/tibble terra SpatRaster.

text: obj HibDatabase object. metrics Character vector dissimilarity/distance metrics. Metrics available via vegan::vegdist: "manhattan", "euclidean", "canberra", "clark", "bray", "kulczynski", "jaccard", "gower", "altGower", "morisita", "horn", "mountford", "raup", "binomial", "chao", "cao", "mahalanobis", "chisq", "chord", "hellinger", "aitchison", "robust.aitchison". available metrics: "hypervolume", "cosine", "theta", "baselga_bray_balanced", "baselga_bray_gradient", "baselga_ruzicka_balanced", "baselga_ruzicka_gradient", "horn_dissim", "normalised_euclidean". Metrics can provided upper lower case - internal processing done using lower-case - unambiguous abbreviations. Note: "horn" refers "Morisita-Horn" index vegan package. "horn_dissim" refers (1 - Horn overlap), calculated endogenously within package. binary Logical vector - metric calculated using occurence values (TRUE) abundance (FALSE, default). single entry, length 'metrics'. Vectors lengths recycled length 'metrics'. rel_abund Logical vector - determining whether relative abundance used calculate dissimilarity metric, applicable metrics, e.g., euclidean, hypervolume. Note: many metrics include rescaling abundances part calculation. Default values TRUE. rescale Logical vector - determining dissimilarity measure rescaled relative maximum value - applies metrics 0-1 scale default - hypervolume, euclidean (relative abundance), chord, hellinger. Default values TRUE. baseline_lui Character NULL, indicating baseline LUI/s compositional dissimilarity calculated per study. NULL, compositional dissimilarity calculated sites within study. title: hibiiscus - Version 0.1
text: Create, update, filter PREDICTS-like databases; add external site, species, site-contrast data. Define custom land-use legends correct abundance measurements sampling effort. Calculate within-site diversity, -site dissimilarity, land-use, geographic, environmental site contrasts. Fit mixed-effects models lme4, brms, INLA, including weighted analyses across multiple datasets. Evaluate models random grouped cross-validation, including predictive performance fold-level coefficients. Project models tabular raster covariates, estimate prediction uncertainty, calculate Area Applicability. Prepare downscaled GLOBIOM NetCDF outputs projection, plot database, model, cross-validation, projection results. Save reload hibiiscus database, land-use legend, model, cross-validation, projection objects.
